_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/omarchy-switchyard/rules.json and edit. version is the rules-file format; leave it at 1. Each entry in rules is tried in order; the first whose host matches wins. A bare host ("basecamp.com") matches only that host; "*.example.com" matches example.com itself and any subdomain. target is a desktop id ("chromium.desktop", "zen.desktop", ...) or the word "webapp", which opens the link as a Chromium web-app window. A link that matches no rule, or any link while this file is missing, goes to the fallback browser in the sibling 'fallback' file, which 'omarchy-switchyard activate' writes and this file never touches.
